sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: I Am Speed - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "When the game's all about holding objectives, every second counts. We've had a lot of fresh meat show up lately. Show them how to actually storm the objectives!"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Capture 12 objectives within one match in CheckPoint mode
